description: This file defines the TopicParseException class used for error handling related to parsing topics within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It includes exception details, builder patterns, and relevant annotations and constants.

classes.name: TopicParseException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a FilteredTopic cannot be parsed from a string, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ConnectivityException.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of TopicParseException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for TopicParseException with the parsed filter string; optionally with a description hint.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a TopicParseException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a TopicParseException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of TopicParseException with updated headers.
